arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Test case sensitivity with search (which works correctly)
result = parse.search('spam {:w}', 'SPAM world SPAM foo', case_sensitive=True)
print('search case_sensitive True:', result.fixed if result else None)

result2 = parse.search('spam {:w}', 'SPAM world SPAM foo')
print('search case_sensitive False:', result2.fixed if result2 else None)

# Now test findall
result3 = list(parse.findall('spam {:w}', 'SPAM world SPAM foo', case_sensitive=True))
print('findall case_sensitive True:', [r.fixed for r in result3])

result4 = list(parse.findall('spam {:w}', 'SPAM world SPAM foo'))
print('findall case_sensitive False:', [r.fixed for r in result4])
"
